gaps: Mutations are intentionally out of scope for v1 (no POST/PUT/DELETE). Adding bookings, editing pet profiles, or running the embedded Explo dashboards' SQL are not supported.
Explo-backed dashboards (the ~30 visual reports) cannot be re-run by the CLI; only the 16 direct CSV-export endpoints are scriptable.
patterns: JWT bearer (AWS Cognito) with browser-derived refresh-token flow.
JSON:API-style nested includes via ?includes[]=path.to.relation, with gte_/lte_/eq_ date filter prefixes.

novel_features.name: Cognito-from-Chrome auth bootstrap
novel_features.description: Sign in once by importing your goose.pet Cognito session from Chrome localStorage; subsequent commands auto-refresh the access token.
novel_features.rationale: Goose has no public auth; without this, every command requires manually pasting a fresh accessToken every hour. The Cognito refresh-token flow is documented but undiscoverable without a working CLI.
novel_features.why_it_matters: First-run setup. Without it, the CLI is unusable beyond an hour. After it, the CLI behaves like any tokened SaaS CLI.

novel_features.name: Composite daily roster with cross-warnings
novel_features.description: Today's arrivals, departures, and currently-here pets — with vaccine-expired, agreement-missing, and balance-due flags surfaced from the booking's join graph.
novel_features.rationale: The web app spreads this across five screens (Dashboard / Bookings / Reports / each customer profile / each pet profile). One endpoint with includes returns it all; we just have to render it.
novel_features.why_it_matters: The morning huddle in one call. Agents picking 'who is at the facility right now' get a single pre-joined payload instead of orchestrating four endpoints.

novel_features.name: Customer one-shot search→detail
novel_features.description: Search-and-resolve in one command: takes a name, phone, or email, returns the full customer record with pets, vouchers, agreements, payments, notes, balance, and recent bookings.
novel_features.rationale: Stitches search-api.goose.pet + admin API + bulk balance endpoint into one render. Web app forces you to click each section sequentially.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Off-hours support calls — answer 'what's the deal with this customer' from the terminal without four browser clicks.

novel_features.name: Pet one-shot lookup
novel_features.description: Find a pet by name and return tags, vaccinations, instructions, current room assignment, owner, and upcoming bookings in one render.
novel_features.rationale: Goose's pet-profile is per-facility (`locationPetProfile`); the URL requires the profile ID. Name-first lookup with rich resolution lives only here.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Quickest answer to 'is Riley current on shots?' or 'where is Riley right now?' for front-desk and on-call.

novel_features.name: Vaccinations expiring × visit window
novel_features.description: Pets with vaccinations expiring within N days. With --by-visit, filter to pets that also have an upcoming booking inside the window.
novel_features.rationale: Goose's documented Expiring-Vaccinations report exists but cannot join to the upcoming-bookings filter. Local SQL closes the gap.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Front-desk wants the lapses that will actually arrive this week, not the full backlog.

novel_features.name: Churn list with voucher overlay
novel_features.description: Customers who haven't booked in N days, optionally restricted to those holding unused vouchers/credits.
novel_features.rationale: Pure local SQL across users + invoices + vouchers; Goose's API has no last-booked-per-user aggregation endpoint.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Marketing re-engagement list in one command instead of Excel-stitching three CSV exports.

novel_features.name: Bulk-export week of CSV reports
novel_features.description: Parallel fan-out over the 16 documented data-export endpoints (sales, customer-activity, agreements, feeding-medication, vaccinations, etc.) for a date range, written to ./reports/<week>/<slug>.csv.
novel_features.rationale: Each CSV export is a real `/api/v1/admin/<facility>/reports/<slug>` endpoint; web app makes you click each one sequentially.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Weekly analytics pull in one command. Agents that ingest sales data don't have to re-implement export orchestration.

novel_features.name: Daily-prep alerts panel
novel_features.description: Single command surfaces operational risk for today: incoming pets with expired vaccinations, customers without an active agreement revision, checkouts with non-zero outstanding balance, and customer vouchers expiring within 7 days.
novel_features.rationale: Joins fresh `dashboard/invoices` includes with the bulk `outstanding-balance` endpoint and the local voucher store. Web app requires hand-correlation across four screens.
novel_features.why_it_matters: The 7am pre-open check — agents or scripts can decide what needs attention before customers walk in.

narrative.headline: Run your goose.pet facility from the terminal — today's roster, customer lookup, vaccine warnings, and bulk CSV exports without leaving your shell.
narrative.value_prop: Goose has no public API and no third-party CLI. This one wraps the admin surface the web app uses: bookings, pets, customers, schedules, and the 16 data-export endpoints behind the Reports page. Sign in once via Chrome and the CLI manages Cognito refresh on its own; novel commands like `today`, `vaccines expiring --by-visit`, and `alerts daily` join across the local store for answers the web app can't give in one click.
narrative.auth_narrative: Goose auth is AWS Cognito (User Pool us-east-2_IqPUw1L4C). The CLI handles this with `goose auth login --chrome`: it reads your existing app.goose.pet session tokens from Chrome's localStorage, persists the refresh token, and mints fresh 1-hour access tokens via Cognito InitiateAuth as needed. If you'd rather not use Chrome, paste an access token: `export GOOSE_ACCESS_TOKEN=<jwt>` (re-paste every hour).

quickstart.comment: Import your goose.pet session from Chrome; CLI manages refresh from here on.
Morning roster — arrivals, departures, here-overnight with warnings.
One-shot customer lookup with pets, vouchers, balance, agreements.
Lapses that affect this month's bookings (not the full backlog).
Pull all 16 weekly CSV exports in parallel.
Pre-open risk panel: expired vaccines, missing agreements, balance due, voucher expiry.

troubleshoots.fix: Run `goose auth login --chrome` to refresh tokens. If Chrome is closed or not logged in, sign in at app.goose.pet first.

troubleshoots.symptom: `vaccines expiring` returns nothing even though the web app says there are some
troubleshoots.fix: Run `goose sync` first — the cross-entity query reads the local SQLite store.
Confirm `--date` matches today's date in your facility's timezone (Goose stores dates per location.timezone, not UTC).
Add more of the name, or pass the ID directly: `goose customers get <userId>`.
Token expired mid-fan-out; re-run `goose auth login --chrome` and retry. The fan-out is idempotent — already-written files are skipped.

narrative.when_to_use: Use this CLI when you operate a goose.pet facility and want scriptable access to the admin surface. Daily-ops checks (today's roster, alerts), customer/pet lookups during off-hours support, bulk weekly CSV exports for the analyst, and cross-entity questions (vaccines × bookings, churn × vouchers) that the web app can't answer in one click.
